rootCauseVerification.hypothesis: WPF SelectionChanged fires before SelectedValue updates, so the old handler persisted empty picks even though SelectedItem already holds the new option.
rootCauseVerification.alternativeHypothesis: The selected item binding fails, or only a detached dropdown event removes an initially correct draft.
rootCauseVerification.distinguishingTest: On win-vm, construct the same WPF ComboBox anonymous-option ItemsSource, set SelectedValue to two, and observe ancestry, SelectedValue and SelectedItem inside SelectionChanged and after the setter. Then exercise the production card controls through two other-card acknowledgements.

predictedObservations.hypothesis: Attached event: SelectedItem is two while SelectedValue is empty; after setter SelectedValue becomes two.
predictedObservations.alternativeHypothesis: Failed binding leaves no SelectedItem, or draft is initially correct and is lost only during a later detached event.

actualObservation: event ancestor=True value= item={ Id = two, Label = Same }
